summary: Deterministically traverse the caller's Cartesian beam grid cell by cell: per-axis exit times, the source two-record plasma-crossing split, adaptive subsegments from a caller parameter callback, one-based cell indices and the DDA terminal policy.

identity.relation: DDA traversal of a Cartesian beam grid from a start position and velocity: exit the current cell at the earliest half-width crossing over the axes (dt_axis = |(cell_center + 0.5*width*sign(v)) - position| / |v| with zero components replaced by the source 1e-3 cm/s working velocity), record the segment midpoint and duration with the one-based cell index, advance to the next cell, and stop on the segment limit, grid exit, or crossing limit. A plasma-flag change between cell endpoints splits the segment into two records at the crossing time located by 50 fixed subdivisions of the duration; adaptive modes (0-7, enabled only with a nonzero split tolerance) replace the single record with ceil-based subsegments capped at max_cell_splits.
identity.direction: start position + velocity + one-based initial cell + caller grid centers/widths + plasma predicate + limits -> source-ordered track segments (midpoint, duration, cell index), crossing count and terminal reason
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM 束网格射线分段跟踪 operator (framework node N3; source anchor src/fidasim.f90:9271-9466, track): cell order, the 50-step crossing split, the adaptive count/cap and one-based indices are ported verbatim. Source quirks preserved: zero velocity returns the empty traversal with terminal_reason zero_velocity; a crossing-limit hit pops the last segment once (the source cc decrement). No get_indices, get_plasma, LOS/Doppler or whole-program neutral transport parity is claimed.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with registered hardenings
identity.geometry: one ray through the caller-declared Cartesian beam grid; cell centers and widths are caller-owned state
identity.coordinates: positions in cm, velocity in cm/s, durations in s; cell indices are one-based source order
identity.boundary: finite 3-vectors; positive finite cell widths; finite one-dimensional center axes; a fractional-free one-based initial index inside the grid; genuine positive integer max_track_segments, max_crossings and max_cell_splits; adaptive_mode an integer in 0..7; a callable plasma predicate; adaptive mode additionally requires a positive finite split tolerance and a callable adaptive parameter callback
assumptions: The plasma predicate is a pure function of position; the caller owns the plasma state it closes over.
Segment records carry the caller's grid state; no grid or HDF5 access happens inside.

inputs.name: velocity_cm_s
inputs.description: Neutral velocity; zero velocity returns the empty traversal.
inputs.constraints: Finite; the zero vector is the source's zero_velocity terminal.

inputs.name: initial_grid_index_one_based
inputs.constraints: Fractional-free positive integers inside the declared axes (registered: fractional values rejected).

inputs.name: max_track_segments
inputs.constraints: A genuine positive integer; bools rejected (registered hardening).

inputs.name: max_crossings
inputs.constraints: A genuine positive integer; bools rejected (registered hardening).

inputs.name: in_plasma_at
inputs.description: Caller plasma predicate at a position.
inputs.constraints: callable(position_cm) -> truth value; the caller owns the plasma state.

inputs.name: adaptive_mode
inputs.constraints: Integer 0..7 (registered: bools rejected); nonzero enables adaptive splitting only with a nonzero split tolerance.

inputs.name: max_cell_splits
inputs.constraints: A genuine positive integer; bools rejected (registered hardening).

inputs.name: split_tolerance
inputs.constraints: Zero (or omitted) keeps the fixed-cell traversal; adaptive mode requires a positive finite value.

inputs.name: adaptive_parameter_at
inputs.description: Caller parameter callback for adaptive splitting.
inputs.constraints: callable(position_cm, mode) -> finite real; required when adaptive mode is active.

outputs.name: segments
outputs.description: Source-ordered track records: midpoint position, duration, one-based cell index.
outputs.constraints: Midpoints and durations finite; indices one-based source-order cells.

outputs.name: plasma_crossings
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative; each crossing stores two source records.

outputs.name: terminal_reason
outputs.constraints: One of ntrack_limit, grid_exit, max_crossings, zero_velocity.

preconditions: A caller-declared Cartesian beam grid with a pure plasma predicate.
supported: Deterministic source-order segment traversal for one neutral ray.
excluded: Plasma sampling, colrad execution, N4 records, RNG, MPI, reservoir updates and whole-program neutral transport.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when vectors are misshaped or non-finite, widths are non-positive, the initial index is fractional or outside the grid, the limits are not genuine positive integers (registered: bools rejected), the adaptive mode is outside 0..7 or not an integer, the plasma predicate is not callable, or an active adaptive mode lacks a positive finite tolerance or a callable parameter callback.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when a crossing or adaptive split cannot be stored within max_track_segments, or when the adaptive parameter callback returns non-finite values.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the traversal stops on the declared terminal policies.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; the returned records are the complete traversal for the declared limits.

python.signature: trace_beam_grid_ray_segments(start_position_cm, velocity_cm_s, initial_grid_index_one_based, x_cell_centers_cm, y_cell_centers_cm, z_cell_centers_cm, cell_width_cm, max_track_segments, max_crossings, in_plasma_at, adaptive_mode=0, max_cell_splits=1, split_tolerance=0.0, adaptive_parameter_at=None)

example.description: The saved package's regular two-cell traversal and its plasma-crossing split.
example.code:
from scirel.fusion import trace_beam_grid_ray_segments
grid = dict(x_cell_centers_cm=[0.0, 1.0, 2.0], y_cell_centers_cm=[0.0, 1.0, 2.0],
            z_cell_centers_cm=[0.0, 1.0, 2.0], cell_width_cm=[1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
            in_plasma_at=lambda p: False)
regular = trace_beam_grid_ray_segments(start_position_cm=[0.0, 0.1, 0.1], velocity_cm_s=[1.0, 0.1, 0.1],
                                       initial_grid_index_one_based=[1, 1, 1],
                                       max_track_segments=2, max_crossings=2, **grid)
assert regular['ntrack'] == 2 and regular['segments'][1]['grid_index_one_based'] == (2, 1, 1)
crossing = trace_beam_grid_ray_segments(start_position_cm=[0.0, 0.1, 0.1], velocity_cm_s=[1.0, 0.1, 0.1],
                                        initial_grid_index_one_based=[1, 1, 1],
                                        max_track_segments=2, max_crossings=2,
                                        in_plasma_at=lambda p: p[0] < 0.25,
                                        x_cell_centers_cm=grid['x_cell_centers_cm'], y_cell_centers_cm=grid['y_cell_centers_cm'],
                                        z_cell_centers_cm=grid['z_cell_centers_cm'], cell_width_cm=grid['cell_width_cm'])
assert crossing['plasma_crossings'] == 1 and crossing['ntrack'] == 2
try:
    trace_beam_grid_ray_segments(start_position_cm=[0.0, 0.1, 0.1], velocity_cm_s=[1.0, 0.1, 0.1],
                                 initial_grid_index_one_based=[1.5, 1, 1], max_track_segments=2,
                                 max_crossings=1, **{k: v for k, v in grid.items() if k != 'in_plasma_at'},
                                 in_plasma_at=grid['in_plasma_at'])
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('a fractional one-based grid index must be rejected')
example.expected: The saved regular and crossing probes reproduce; the fractional index is rejected.
